newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends sharply up as top quality rice firm.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends sharply up as top quality rice firm.

text.p: A firm market for high quality cash rice boosted CBOT rice futures to a higher close with fund buying leading the way up, traders said.
"The market refuses to go down on continued demand for long grain paddy and even in Asia there is good demand for high quality rice," a trader said.
Traders said the Jasmine, or top quality rice in Thailand, was being priced at $560.00 per tonne, well above U.S. paddy rice at $440.00 per ton.
Also, "China continues to buy high grade rice globally," the trader said.
Traders also said the U.S. farm cash basis for rice remains very strong and local buying in futures Monday helped reinforce fund demand.
Rice futures volume jumped to 1,000 contracts from Friday's 358, according to the CBOT.
Rice closed 16 to 21 cents per cwt higher, with January up 21 at $10.95 per cwt.
